headline: Front Ledger Records Fresh Movement at Tempest
war_summary: Since the previous edition, the ledger has registered fresh movement at Tempest Island: one ownership event in the latest two hours and three across the day, with its nine bases still Colonial-held. Fisherman’s Row remains the busiest recorded sector, though its 23 daily events have fallen quiet in the latest two hours; the Wardens hold eight of nine bases. Deadlands likewise shows no fresh event in the latest two hours, but remains divided eight Colonial bases to three Warden and recorded 14 events across the day amid sharply accelerating casualty and enlistment rates. Stema Landing has six daily events, including six in the latest six-hour window, while its nine bases remain Colonial-held. Lykos Isle has recorded five daily events and three in six hours, with the split now three Warden to four Colonial. Farranac Coast retains three daily events and a two-to-nine Warden-to-Colonial split, but its fighting pace is cooling. Kings Cage, Stlican Shelf, and Weathered Expanse remain heavy casualty fronts without recorded base events in the current day, while several rear sectors report little or no contact.
